# CHD build-spec integration — revision 2026-11-11
**Verdict: NOT YET BUILDABLE.** This is a local specification integration, not a CHD runtime release. The authoritative gap disposition is INDEX §8; the concise release decision is [VERDICT.md](VERDICT.md). All paths in code spans in this document are relative to the package root unless stated otherwise.

## 1. Authority and selected surfaces
Confirmed owner decisions govern, including D-038 and D-039. Next, this integration contract and the exact domain selections below override contradictory older text. The six integrated deliverables are adopted only within the stated boundaries. Historical audit snapshots are evidence, never a parallel contract. A newer timestamp alone conveys no authority. Generated outputs cannot amend their inputs.
| Domain | Selected file | Superseded / retained boundary | |---|---|---| | Current configuration | `contracts/config.schema.json`, `build-spec/integrated/config-format.md`, adjacent reference validator and examples | v4 only for activation. `contracts/historical-v2/` is explicit compatibility history, never deployment input. Old VOL-D §1 spellings/default claims and handbook config schemas are historical where different. | | Controller HTTP wire | `contracts/openapi.yaml`, `build-spec/integrated/wire-api.md` | Replaces `contracts/ENDPOINTS.md` wire shapes and generic handbook tools envelopes. 59 operations preserve all OP-001..048 identities. No native adapter is invented. | | Gateway identity / allocation semantics | `contracts/gateway-identity.md`, `contracts/request-attempt-lifecycle.md` | Replaces W-D11, VOLC-022/send-only keys and headerless-NEW recipes. G-04 transport binding remains OPEN. | | CLI | `build-spec/integrated/cli-interface.md`, `build-spec/integrated/cli-catalog/` | Existing Muster, not a bespoke CHD CLI. Retain IF-01..IF-07 limitations. Config/record wrapper validation and Go transport are scaffolding; no controller behavior claimed. | | Lifecycle | `contracts/request-attempt-lifecycle.md`, `handbook/chd32/tables/section11-lifecycle-source.json` | Identity/stop/visibility semantics adopted. Old root `state-machines.json` and conflicting tables are non-conforming reference projections pending G-05/G-14, not alternate valid transitions. | | Acceptance | INDEX §8 dispositions and this document's release gates | Old root fixture suite and ten handbook workflow fixtures remain evidence/reference only until G-11 reconciles their assertions. No existing fixture PASS is full conformance. |
The generated manifest enumerates files with an explicit role: normative, reference, evidence, generated or historical. Normative inventory membership is subject to the domain exclusions above; it does not make an unresolved proposal implemented or independently buildable. `build-spec/INDEX.md` §7 is a historical R32 delivery ledger, not evidence that every finding closed. Legacy requirement counts remain a baseline census, not a release-completion metric.

### Configuration, D-038/D-039 and explicit workers
Adopt all nine format decisions in `build-spec/integrated/config-format.md` §1.2. The sole root policy spelling is `session`; project override precedes agent override, then global. Permission authority remains VP > director > manager. Fork modes are choices, not an ordered strictness lattice: only authorized VP-authored override selection is accepted; downstream authority may not invent a wider mode. The full decision table in §5.3 governs additions/removals/incomparable grant sets. No automatic live-session refresh.
D-039 is settled: every restore and lost-session replacement resolves current policy before activation. Archived snapshots remain history; store source and effective revision separately. A missing source revision must not be fabricated. Existing live-session restart retains its bound snapshot. A real same-profile fork defaults to preserve-parent, with current-policy only as the explicit authorized alternative. These rules supersede VOL-B restore step 6 and activation table, VOLD-063 and INDEX's old D038-LIFECYCLE expectation. G-02 remains OPEN only for all prose/schema/fixture projections and source-revision nullability to be reconciled; it is not an owner decision to reopen.
Fully explicit temporary workers are supported; missing fields fail closed with their named path. Blanket `temporary_agents_unspecified` is retired for complete requests. Defaults remain unset; no model, provider, lifetime, privilege or retention is guessed. Lower-tier creation requires configured create authority, provisioned credentials and readback. Config v2/v3 is not silently upgraded: preserve historical validation separately, emit an operator-reviewed migration diff, validate complete v4 before any effects. `contracts/validate_config.py` invokes the v4 reference validator; the historical command cannot arm v4.

### Wire decisions W-D01..W-D16
Adopt W-D01..W-D10 and W-D12..W-D16 as specification design choices, **not retroactive owner-confirmed defaults**. Their table is retained in the integrated wire document. W-D11's three-member digest is rejected because it omits profile/credential and full target scope. The exact replacement is `contracts/gateway-identity.md` and the canonical OpenAPI `x-gateway-contract`. First-turn targeting follows committed native allocation for NEW and REUSE; ordinary chat POST cannot stand in for allocation proof. Alias requests share the canonical dedupe namespace; raw JSON Schema constraints are never weakened for codegen/Muster.

### Readiness, capacity and storage
Read-only, immediate and scheduled readiness are separate. Read-only requires an authenticated authoritative read path; immediate additionally requires config/profile/credential/policy/runtime capabilities, current storage writer authority and shared capacity reservation. Scheduled readiness additionally requires scheduler registration/readback. Scheduler outage alone does not disable an otherwise-ready immediate path; no fail-open authority or second capacity ledger is permitted. No write/immediate readiness is claimed before G-12's fencing/snapshot binding exists.
Capacity belongs to the attempt/run reservation. Report receipt, logical-send closure, waiting, timeout, lease expiry, cancellation intent or uncorrelated process absence cannot release it. Only verified correlated provider/runtime terminal proof, committed and audited, releases it. G-06 retains the missing concrete stop attestation and fault-trace obligation.
DuckBrain pin `972aeb0023973b2d62186a748eab5ccede2dd0f8` does not supply the required linearizable lease, atomic storage-boundary fence or complete concurrent snapshot primitive. An external lease checked before an unfenced POST does not close the race. The storage catalog's `physical_tables`, `sql_statements`, `ddl_indexes` remain empty. Do not implement control-state authority in a second SQLite ledger. G-12 also retains generation/key migration, nullable archive fields, historical criteria-set membership, journal wrappers and immutable dataset-registry binding. A raw document wrapper is not a writer protocol.

## 3. References and supersession
`contracts/OPERATIONS.md` now resolves the missing operation citation to the canonical HTTP/interface and operation reference. `build-spec/VOL-F-reference-map.md` resolves historical VOL-F labels to actual archive/audit/federation sections; it is a replacement map, not a claim that native restore is implemented. R32 shorthand is rooted explicitly under `handbook/chd32/`, never guessed to be root `schemas/` or `src/`.
Existing volumes retain baseline requirements outside overridden domains. Their audit-cited inconsistent passages are non-conforming projections, and INDEX §8 names each remaining repair. The downstream CHD-3.5 authoring card owns rewriting handbook sections/figures and synchronizing those projections. No full-build claim is permitted until the remaining OPEN release blockers have verified dispositions.

## 4. Verification and release boundaries
Run `python3 build-spec/tools/check_integration.py` and `python3 build-spec/tools/gen_manifest.py --check` from the package root. The latter checks both manifest and reference-index content/file inventory, not merely hashes of rows that happen to remain. Generate indexes only after source edits. The autogen README gives pinned bootstrap, real tests and exact-HEAD regeneration commands. CLI catalog source hashes must equal canonical OpenAPI; operation, required-field and nested-schema changes must fail parity. IF-06/IF-07 are known failures of the pinned MCP adapter, so catalog loading is not a fidelity PASS.
Offline evidence can prove file/reference closure, schema/example validation, deterministic generation, compilation, identity encoding and deliberate negative controls. It cannot prove native capability, crash durability, distributed fencing, runtime authority, stop attestation or owner acceptance. Runtime traces must record exact versions/inputs, observed writes/readbacks and negative outcomes; canned fixture records cannot satisfy them.
This task completes integration by recording every audit gap as closed or OPEN with a specific disposition. It does not silently narrow the required product. The required restore, safe dispatch and lifecycle semantics remain required even while their implementation contracts are unresolved.
